svg.title: IgM pentamer schematic
svg.desc: Five schematic IgM monomers with Cmu2/Cmu3/Cmu4 constant-region domains and an asymmetric J-chain symbol in the open sector. Rounded domain cartoon, not an atomic model. Structural reference: Nature Communications 2022,
